topic: The 5-minute daily habit your heart will thank you for

hook.text: Your heart wants five minutes from you. Today.

beats.text: Here's the habit: a brisk five-minute walk, every day. After lunch, after a call, whenever you've been sitting too long.
Brisk means you can still talk, but not sing.
Regular activity like this can lower your risk of heart disease and stroke.
The goal for adults is about 150 minutes a week, and you can break it into small chunks.
So start with five. When it feels easy, make it ten.

cta: Save this, and take your five-minute walk today.
